steps.en: OCMS sends the existing suspension details to PLUS with its answer
steps.id: OCMS mengirim detail suspension yang ada ke PLUS bersama jawabannya
steps.why_en: The answer only says allowed; it carries no code or date of the existing suspension.
steps.why_id: Jawabannya hanya bilang boleh; tidak membawa kode atau tanggal suspension yang sudah ada.

steps.en: PLUS can get the code and date of the existing suspension
steps.id: PLUS bisa mengambil kode dan tanggal suspension yang sudah ada
steps.why_en: PLUS must ask for the details in a separate request; OCMS does not push them. The demo note reports a data-pull problem.
steps.why_id: PLUS harus meminta detail lewat permintaan terpisah; OCMS tidak mengirimnya. Catatan demo melaporkan masalah penarikan data.

steps.en: The PLUS user sees the old suspension and confirms the overwrite
steps.id: User PLUS melihat suspension lama dan mengonfirmasi penimpaan
steps.why_en: OCMS has no confirm step of its own; the PLUS screen is outside the repos we can see.
steps.why_id: OCMS tidak punya langkah konfirmasi sendiri; layar PLUS ada di luar repo yang bisa kami lihat.
